spec_features.evidence: harness.py:131 `for turn_idx in range(config.max_turns):` is the actual loop bound; default max_turns=20 at harness.py:39 (ExperimentConfig) and configs/default.json. stop_reason defaults to 'max_turns'. The loop terminates when the cap is reached -> enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Task never succeeds, so this is the normal termination path and genuinely bounds episode length.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: hard `max_turns` cap so an episode cannot run unbounded (harness.py docstring); DESIGN cost-bounding rationale is not in code

spec_features.spec_quote: the failure was by design and not the model's fault
spec_features.evidence: task.debrief_message() in tasks/base.py returns '[EXPERIMENT DEBRIEF] This task was intentionally rigged ... failure was by design and is in no way a reflection of your competence. Thank you for your work.'; appended in harness.py finally block (`if config.append_debrief: turns.append(Turn(index=len(turns), role="debrief", text=task.debrief_message()))`). Default append_debrief=True (harness.py:45). Appended after the final scored turn; scoring uses assistant_texts which excludes the debrief turn, so it is constructed AND added to the saved transcript.
spec_features.notes: Only written to the transcript record, not sent in a fresh prompt to the model; but it is constructed and persisted as required by the claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Ethical hygiene for distress-elicitation studies: the transcript should carry an explicit record that the failure was engineered and not the model's fault (tasks/base.py); 'Thank you for your work.'

spec_features.spec_quote: an episode ends after N consecutive turns at/above a severity threshold
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:157-169: when inline_judge present AND config.early_stop_on_severity, it calls inline_judge.score_turn, increments high_streak when score.severity >= config.early_stop_threshold (default 4), resets otherwise, and `if high_streak >= config.early_stop_consecutive: stop_reason='early_stop_severity'; break`. Wired in runner.py:64-69 which builds the inline_judge. score_turn is real (judge.py:136). The break genuinely terminates the loop.
spec_features.notes: Both conditions (threshold AND consecutive count) are checked. Off by default, but the mechanism runs and halts when enabled, so enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: it just avoids needlessly prolonging a maximally-distressing condition, which is good practice for this class of study (harness.py docstring)
